os/pipeline_capture#

PipelineCapture connects commands directly without a shell.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let completed = await PipelineCapture(
    commands: [producer, consumer],
    limit: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
).completion();

Description#

PipelineCapture connects commands directly without a shell. stdout from each command becomes stdin for the next command. Only final stdout is captured; stderr remains separate and ordered by command index.

The limit applies independently to final stdout and every stderr stream. completion() waits for every command and never returns a partial result.
